headline: Copper Falls 1% in London as US Election Weighs on AI and Tariffs
summary: Copper declined 1% to $13,712 per ton on the London Metal Exchange as the US election weighed on the artificial intelligence and tariff trade.
why: Copper is a vital industrial metal and a primary economic indicator, widely tracked by investors to gauge global manufacturing health and demand trends, particularly in heavy industry and technology sectors.
